description: MCP protocol and server conformance checks, including existing Compass-owned checks.

http-support.name: HTTP Support
http-support.description: Server responds correctly over HTTP with parseable JSON-RPC.

protocol-compliance.name: Protocol Compliance
protocol-compliance.description: MCP initialize, capability negotiation, and JSON-RPC 2.0 correctness.

schema-conformance.name: Schema Conformance
schema-conformance.description: Tool input/output schemas are well-formed JSON Schema objects.

rate-limiting.name: Rate Limiting
rate-limiting.description: Server returns HTTP 429 under burst load (20-request burst).

response-size-limit.name: Response Size Limit
response-size-limit.description: Server enforces response size cap. Deferred to Phase 3.

mandatory-timeouts.name: Mandatory Timeouts
mandatory-timeouts.description: Server enforces bounded response time. Deferred to Phase 3.

openapi-conformance.name: OpenAPI Conformance
openapi-conformance.description: Server publishes and conforms to an OpenAPI 3.x contract (or MCP-native equivalent).

consumed_track_checks.name: MCP Tool Schema Check
consumed_track_checks.description: Tool names must be 1–128 characters using only A-Za-z0-9, underscore, hyphen, and dot.

consumed_track_checks.name: OAuth Matches Catalog
consumed_track_checks.description: Catalog-declared OAuth scopes and auth server URL match the server PRM.
